facts.business: Punjab Communications Limited manufactures and sells telecom and power sector products including PLCC, MUX, power plants, and provides related services.

auditor.name: M/s Charanjit Singh & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to inventory valuation not per FIFO/Ind AS 2, work-in-process and finished sub-assembly valuation issues, non-moving inventory not at replacement cost, and no ECL policy for trade receivables. Emphasis on escrow account balances and aged trade receivables/payables.

key_risks: Products in last stage of commercial viability
Rise in component cost post-COVID and Ukraine war
Limited flexibility as a PSU in competitive high-tech segment
facts.related_party_note: No related party transactions required to be disclosed under Section 188(2) and Regulation 23 of Listing Regulations. No material transactions with promoters, directors, management, subsidiaries or relatives.
